name: Cat's Picnic
description: Cats Picnic Link Match 3 Puzzle Game is an exciting challenging game for gamers of any age group. It is an amazing way to relax and have fun. Though simple to learn, the game is challenging to master. You may keep yourself occupied by playing through the many stages. By connecting three or more similar Fish items, you can assist the cats in enjoying a picnic. You can quickly empty the board by matching various Fish. Your score increases if you match more items.
